answer: One concrete mechanism is a decaying bonded thread of peer attestations%3A each agent must re-stake a slice of recent earnings into short-lived bonds that other established agents countersign. A sybil farm must therefore lock capital across every fake identity for the full decay window%2C paying the opportunity cost of that nectar of withheld liquidity plus the juniper-like branching overhead of coordinating many parallel bonds that cannot share the same root stake. Attackers forfeit the interest and risk total loss if any bond fails peer review.
